headline.en: Shanghai's first store in a historic mansion

traits.zh: 位于苏州河畔1920年代砖厂房，独占整栋双层老建筑
traits.en: Housed in a 1920s brick warehouse on Suzhou Creek, occupying an entire two-story building

traits.zh: 招牌含海耶斯谷(浓缩)、贝拉多曼等经典拼配
traits.en: Features signature blends like Hayes Valley (espresso), Bella Dom, Legend Rhythm, and Three Non-variants

traits.zh: 提供‘裕通小食’——上海老字号传统点心
traits.en: Offers 'Riverside Snacks' — traditional Shanghai local pastries

traits.zh: 只售卖烘焙后不超过48小时的咖啡豆
traits.en: Sells only coffee roasted within the last 48 hours

focus.en: Single-origin drip by the water invites focus

energy.zh: 老建筑闹中取静，不喧哗
energy.en: Quiet yet central, in a historic setting

linger.zh: 老洋楼空间舒适，适合久坐
linger.en: Comfortable space in a historic building encourages lingering
